script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A warm, dimly-lit apartment. LUCAS, mid 30s, sits in an armchair, a book in hand, eyes red from weeping. He looks up as the door swings open.

LUCAS
(softly)
Maggie?

MAGGIE, late 20s, enters, a concerned expression on her face. She closes the door gently and approaches him.

MAGGIE
Lucas, what's wrong?

LUCAS stands, wiping his tears away.

LUCAS
I found an old letter. From you.

Maggie winces, guilt etched on her face.

MAGGIE
Lucas, I'm so sorry. I never meant for you to find that.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

Flashback to several months ago. Lucas cooks breakfast as Maggie enters, wrapped in a towel. She looks at the letter lying on the counter.

MAGGIE
(whispering)
Lucas... this isn't what it looks like.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Present day.

LUCAS
(frustrated)
Why didn't you tell me? You left me without a word.

MAGGIE
(tearfully)
I was afraid. I thought if you knew, you'd leave me.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Months prior. Lucas and Maggie sit across from each other, their faces filled with tension.

LUCAS
(angrily)
Why didn't you trust me?

MAGGIE
(defensively)
I did trust you! But I couldn't face the disappointment in your eyes.

INT. APARTMENT BEDROOM - NIGHT

Back to the present. Lucas sits on the edge of the bed.

LUCAS
(softly)
Maggie, I don't want disappointment. I want forgiveness.

MAGGIE enters, looking unsure.

MAGGIE
Lucas, I've asked for yours, but I haven't been able to give it fully.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

Months ago. Maggie, looking remorseful, packs her belongings.

MAGGIE
(sobbing)
I'm sorry, Lucas. I love you, but I can't stay here. I can't keep living a lie.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Present day. Lucas takes Maggie's hands in his.

LUCAS
(earnestly)
You don't have to. I forgive you.

Maggie looks up at him, surprise in her eyes.

MAGGIE
(whispering)
You do?

LUCAS nods.

LUCAS
Yes, Maggie. I do.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - MORNING

The sun streams in through the windows as Lucas and Maggie embrace. They share a tender kiss, their faces filled with love and forgiveness.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
